Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: See System Event Codes below

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Tradelogiq disseminates stock directory messages for all supported securities.

Field.Name: Market
Field.Description: Indicates the listing market of security

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol on Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Board Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates a board lot size

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Shortable
Field.Description: Indicates the short status of a security

Field.Name: Dividend Indicator
Field.Description: Dividend frequency of the security

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Indicates currency for the symbol

Message.Name: Extended Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: Extended Stock Directory messages carry the additional reference data of bonds, debentures, rights, notes and warrants.

Field.Name: Market
Field.Description: Indicates the listing market of security

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol on Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Board Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates a board lot size

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Shortable
Field.Description: Indicates the short status of a security

Field.Name: Frequency
Field.Description: Dividend frequency of the security

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Indicates currency for the symbol

Field.Name: Security Type
Field.Description: Instrument class of the security

Field.Name: Expiry Date
Field.Description: Date of expiry in the format YYYYMMDD

Field.Name: Description
Field.Description: Description of Security

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Stock Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Tradelogiq uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a security.

Field.Name: Trading State
Field.Description: The current trading state for the issue

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Reason the security is halted. Note: Field may be blank

Message.Name: Add Order Message
Message.Description: An Add Order Message indicates that a new order has been accepted by Omega ATS or Lynx ATS and was added to the visible order book.

Field.Name: Buy/Sell Indicator
Field.Description: Side of order

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: Unique reference number assigned to the new order.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Total number of shares associated with the order being added to the book

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The display price of the new order.

Field.Name: Exec Broker ID
Field.Description: Firm number or '1' for anonymous orders

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Marker
Field.Description: Used to denote specialty markers

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The Order Reference Number associated with the executed order

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares executed

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Day unique Match Number for this execution.

Field.Name: Contra Broker ID
Field.Description: Broker number for contra side or '1' for anonymous

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Order Executed with Price Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is executed at a display price different from the original.

Field.Name: Marker
Field.Description: Used to denote specialty markers

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The Order Reference Number associated with the executed order

Field.Name: Executed Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares executed

Field.Name: Execution Price
Field.Description: The display price of this execution if different from the original.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Day unique Match Number for this execution.

Field.Name: Contra Broker ID
Field.Description: Broker number for contra side or '1' for anonymous

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Order Delete Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is being cancelled.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The Order Reference Number associated with the cancelled order

Message.Name: Order Replace Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book has been cancelled and replaced.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Original Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The original reference number of the order being replaced

Field.Name: New Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The order reference number for this order at time of replacement

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The new total displayed quantity

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The new display price for the order

Message.Name: Order Cancel Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order on the book is modified as a result of a partial cancellation.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Order Reference Number
Field.Description: The reference number of the order being reduced.

Field.Name: Cancelled Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares to be removed from the display size of the order as the result of a cancellation

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: The Trade Message is designed to provide execution details for normal match events involving non-displayed order types.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of execution. Note: side will always be 'B'

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Midpoint Book Trade
Field.Description: Yes represents Midpoint Book trade on Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares executed

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of the execution

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Day unique match number for this execution.

Field.Name: Buy Broker ID
Field.Description: Buy broker number or '1' for anonymous

Field.Name: Sell Broker ID
Field.Description: Sell broker number or '1' for anonymous

Message.Name: Cross Trade Message
Message.Description: Cross trades are only accepted on Omega ATS.

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: The kind of cross being reported

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares executed

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price of execution

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Day unique Match Number for this trade

Field.Name: Buy Broker ID
Field.Description: Buy broker number or '1' for anonymous

Field.Name: Sell Broker ID
Field.Description: Sell broker number or '1' for anonymous

Field.Name: Bypass
Field.Description: Whether the cross bypassed the order book

Field.Name: Settlement Type
Field.Description: Settlement terms of the cross

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Trade Bust Message
Message.Description: The Trade Bust message is sent whenever an execution on Omega ATS or Lynx ATS is cancelled.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: Day unique Match Number of execution being cancelled.

Message.Name: Trade Amend Message
Message.Description: The Trade Amend/Correction message is sent whenever an execution on Omega ATS or Lynx ATS is amended.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Instrument ID
Field.Description: Internal instrument identifier for Omega ATS and Lynx ATS

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Original Trade ID
Field.Description: Original internal number of the given trade transaction

Field.Name: Original Trade Price
Field.Description: Original price associated with the trade transaction

Field.Name: Original Trade Size
Field.Description: Trade Size reported on the original trade transaction

Field.Name: Corrected Trade Price
Field.Description: Price associated with the trade correction reported

Field.Name: Corrected Trade Size
Field.Description: Number of shares with the trade correction

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: Outside of timestamp messages, the start of day message is the first message sent out in a trading day

Value.Name: Start of System Hours
Value.Description: This message indicates that Tradelogiq is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Market Hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are available for execution.

Value.Name: End of Market Hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are no longer available for execution.

Value.Name: End of System Hours
Value.Description: It indicates that Tradelogiq is now closed and will not accept any new orders.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: This is always the last message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Trading Halted
Value.Description: Trading Halted due to Market-Wide Circuit Breaker

Value.Name: Trading Resumed
Value.Description: Trading Resumed following Market-Wide Circuit Breaker

Value.Name: Yes
Value.Description: Yes represents Midpoint Book trade on Lynx ATS
